tables.name: body_daily
tables.doc: One row per day of body measurements, usually from a watch or phone.

tables.name: workouts
tables.doc: Each workout with its start and end, e.g. from Apple Fitness or a watch. The Time page uses the times; body_daily.workout_min is the daily total. A workout paused along the way can be one row per stretch of moving (the Apple Health importer writes it so), so the minutes are the time spent moving. `end` must be after `start`.

tables.name: self_report
tables.doc: How you said you felt, on a 0–5 scale. Optional; pages show a prompt when it is empty.

tables.name: screen_sessions
tables.doc: Foreground app sessions across your devices. Overlaps between devices are allowed; dayring counts wall-clock time once, preferring the device order in dayring.toml. `end` must be after `start`.

tables.name: events
tables.doc: Calendar blocks: classes, work shifts, planned training.

tables.name: deadlines
tables.doc: Things due on a date: assignments, exams, milestones.
